description: This file defines SwiftUI views related to gateway discovery within the OpenClaw application. It includes components for displaying a list of discovered gateways with interactive selection capabilities and a menu for gateway selection.

classes.name: GatewayDiscoveryInlineList
classes.description: A SwiftUI View that displays a list of gateways discovered, allowing user interaction and selection.

classes.name: GatewayDiscoveryMenu
classes.description: A SwiftUI View that presents a menu of discovered gateways for selection.

methods.name: displayInfo
methods.description: Returns display label and selection status for a gateway based on transport method.

methods.name: trimmed
methods.description: Utility function to trim whitespace and newlines from a string.
